Actions.Text: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION

Title: Relates to audiovisual advertisements and synthetic performer disclosures and materially deceptive media disclosures in certain political communications
Summary: Requires disclosure for the entire duration that a synthetic performer is featured in an audiovisual advertisement; requires materially deceptive media disclosures in video political communications to be visible for the entire duration that materially deceptive media is shown.
LawCode: Amd §396-b, Gen Bus L; amd §14-106, El L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to audiovisual advertisements and synthetic performer disclosures; and to amend the election law, in relation to materially deceptive media disclosures in certain political communications
